_comment: The retrieval gold set (MESHSAT-862, 10 September 2026). Ten questions a session actually asks
while building a board, each with the document that answers it. kb_verify.py --gold runs them
and requires an accepted document in the top k.
Every `accept` entry below was found mechanically, by searching the indexed text of this store
for a phrase only the right document carries, and reading back which file and page held it. It
is not a list written from memory, because a gold set written from memory measures the memory.
Two entries name the same document twice: microchip/microchip-ksz9897-datasheet.pdf and
cluster/ksz9897.pdf are the same Microchip datasheet filed in two folders, so either is right.
